rules.rule: Use pinned Astryx actions and input fields in guided creation and preserve the three existing entry contracts.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §11.3A and §13 R1. The correction is limited to new guided creation, author draft reopening and the embedded author preorder handover.
rules.initialization: The same loaded form and current source provide customer, PO and wizard state. Original non-guided single-document readers keep their existing behavior.
rules.dateAndPermission: Business dates, roles, state guards and per-PO quantities retain their original owners. Native picker bounds retain the original min/max hints while the existing noValidate form preserves typed dates for the server and short-lead approval.
rules.expectation: Signed browsers verify absent and present picker minimum, unset date retained through calendar loading, exact typed earlier commitment submitted to original approval without an order, 390 px at 200%, and original PO, dates, reload and keyboard focus.

rules.rule: Use the same themed search and buttons for both restored browser drafts and saved server drafts.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §11.3A and §13 R1. The correction is limited to new guided creation, author draft reopening and the embedded author preorder handover.
rules.initialization: Server-acknowledged drafts retain their source ID, version and original local recovery state. An old development URL resumes the compatible current wizard.
rules.dateAndPermission: The authenticated recovery path, command key and original receipt checks remain the authority. Search preserves composing Chinese input.
rules.expectation: Server search, separate signed reopen and two local drafts pass. The early pending receipt branch uses the same official scoped theme and original command key, and its keyboard action performs only the authorized read.

rules.rule: Use pinned selectors for new craft choices, template, units, washing and saved sample links without changing document identity.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §11.3A and §13 R1. The correction is limited to new guided creation, author draft reopening and the embedded author preorder handover.
rules.initialization: Use existing craft and file option sets. The legacy original form keeps its existing inputs. The label for an existing board or sample distinguishes different saved files.
rules.dateAndPermission: Saved requirement versions and attachment IDs remain exact. The unchanged APIs enforce ownership and ready status.
rules.expectation: The signed browser chooses the saved board, retains its exact attachment ID through real save/reload and reopens an old draft link with the original ordered choices.

rules.rule: Use pinned controls in the designer preorder handover while preserving explicit actual time and original stages.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §11.3A and §13 R1. The correction is limited to new guided creation, author draft reopening and the embedded author preorder handover.
rules.initialization: The existing embedded designer form builds from the current original saved preparation document and continues to use the original endpoint, receipt and attachment contracts.
rules.dateAndPermission: The existing native datetime-local remains only for the explicit Beijing actual occurrence. Astryx v0.7.16 DateTimeInput fills a default time after a date-only selection, which would manufacture a factual hour. No acceptance or SLA logic changes.
rules.expectation: The browser activates the two official add-material buttons by keyboard, checks focus returns to each new row, selects the real eligible merchant and checks the returned exact handover version and actor. The original merchant continues from My Tasks. Formal conversion retains the same procurement and attachment history.
